title: Yoisaki Kanade — Beyond The Screen...〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki. I've made a demo of the song up to the hook. Can you listen to it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Phew!
I'm more or less done with the illustrations too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've just finished a good portion of the video as well.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, can we all take a short breather?
There's something I want to talk to everyone about.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't mind, but what's this about?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yup!
Does everyone want to go watch this movie together?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?
This is a movie of a really obscure anime, isn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You want us to make a special trip down to see it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Obscure or not, I like it!
Though, it's true only a few movie theaters are screening it, and only at night...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This movie director's previous film was pretty good.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I received a lot of inspiration from it for my songs.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<See, see?
Watching a movie can help with our songs!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <If we all watch the same movie, we can discuss it together, and that may become a good inspiration for us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hm... Well, if K's going, I'll think about it too...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We're already in the tweaking stage for our current song, and you'll need inspiration for the next song, won't you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I can smell your desperation all the way here, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <None of my other friends seem interested, that's why.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I could totally go by myself, but I wanna talk about the movie with someone after that and share my thoughts!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I don't have a reason to say no, so why not.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, let's decide on the date.
Which of these days is everyone free?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, what was the title of the previous movie you watched?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Ah... I'm curious about that too.
I'd love to watch a movie that K's watched before.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wow... I just read the synopsis and it's surprisingly interesting. I'll watch it before we meet.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'll watch it too.
Then I can compare it with the new one.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (We've had more opportunities to meet and talk lately.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm sure this must be a good thing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right now, I'm not good enough to make a song that can save Yuki yet. So I have to keep absorbing new things.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So that I can compose better songs...
